messages:
maria_prod: Quick kickoff — we need to finalize reserved-pool sprint scope for Dedicated next quarter. thinking 3 workstreams: core-reserve SLA, burst-smoothing MVP, and quota visibility risk cards. wanting a short decision thread.
kevin_eng: +1 on the 3 lanes. question: do we force-require customers to opt-in for burst-smoothing or enable it by default behind a flag?
olivia_pm: leaning opt-in for GA. customers with strict SLAs shouldn't have hidden behavior changes. opt-in gives us safer rollout and metrics.
sasha_sre: opt-in makes sense. also want explicit drain behavior in preempt windows. if burst spills, prefer graceful spillover over instant evict. we should list failure modes.
liam_data: added a short telemetry plan: we need per-tenant token throughput, tail-latency P95/P99, and burst-hit-rate. will build a dashboard card and a small probe set.
kevin_eng: rough engineering constraints: core-reserve requires per-pool admission controller and tenant tagging. burst-smoothing MVP can be a middleware layer using `elastic-window-v0` and a small leaky-bucket. prototyped this already.
maria_prod: nice. can you paste the config sketch?
kevin_eng: ```
pool_config:
  mode: reserved
  burst_policy:
    smoothing: elastic-window-v0
    max_inflight: 1200
    grace_spill_pct: 15
```
maria_prod: perfect. olivia, would you accept "opt-in by default with clear UI toggle and billing consent" vs fully manual sales onboarding?
olivia_pm: Acceptable if legal signs off on billing notice. prefer explicit sales touch for customers >$X/mo.
sasha_sre: launch criteria proposal: 1) autoscale integration tested in two regions, 2) SLO regression < 5% P99 latency against baseline, 3) a rollback plan and preempt simulation runbook.
liam_data: add monitoring: "burst_lift_ratio" and "spillover_events" to the alerting map. set initial thresholds conservative.
maria_prod: Decision: proceed with opt-in toggle for GA, sales-assisted for enterprise customers, implement grace_spill_pct default 15%, and require the three launch criteria Sasha listed. owners: Kevin (eng), Sasha (SRE), Liam (telemetry), Olivia (PM ops).
ops-bot: Reminder set: @channel Sprint planning sync tomorrow 10:00. Deck + risk cards due 24h before. :bell:
kevin_eng: I'll drop a short PR with the admission-controller interface and an RFC link.
olivia_pm: I'll assemble risk cards (billing, data residency, SLA mismatch) and push to the roadmap spreadsheet.
maria_prod: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. small follow-ups only after the sync pls. :rocket:
